# TapeBackup.org: LTO Tape Backup and Price Tracker

> Independent reference for LTO (Linear Tape-Open) tape backup: current LTO-6 to LTO-10 cartridge and drive prices from seller listings, price history since September 2025, buying guides, backup software comparisons and short technical answers.

## Current LTO prices (October 2026, checked 23 October 2026)
- [LTO-6 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto6-price): 2.5 TB native; cartridge $38.00 to $56.60 ($15.20 to $22.64 per TB); WORM $69.65 to $95.00; external drive $4,937.
- [LTO-7 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto7-price): 6 TB native; cartridge $62.75 to $79.99 ($10.46 to $13.33 per TB); WORM $87.95 to $111.72; internal drive $3,419 to $4,253; external drive $4,999 to $5,598.
- [LTO-8 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto8-price): 12 TB native; cartridge $70.25 to $84.36 ($5.85 to $7.03 per TB); WORM $96.10 to $170.00; internal drive $4,850 to $8,985; external drive $7,300 to $10,433.
- [LTO-9 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto9-price): 18 TB native; cartridge $92.45 to $129.00 ($5.14 to $7.17 per TB); WORM $124.94 to $175.00; internal drive $8,009 to $13,329; external drive $9,199 to $15,225.
- [LTO-10 price guide](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/lto10-price): 30 TB native; cartridge $259.00 to $299.99 ($8.63 to $10.00 per TB); WORM $420.00 to $460.80; external drive $23,422 to $24,950.
- LTO-10 40 TB cartridge: $491.00 to $555.00 ($12.28 to $13.88 per TB). LTO-10 drives are full height only and do not read older generations.

## Core pages
- [LTO price tracker](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend): all generations side by side with method and market notes.
- [LTO price history](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-price-trend/history): archived snapshots from September 2025 onward.
- [Backup calculator](https://tapebackup.org/backup-calculator): tape, disk or cloud recommendation with cartridge count and media cost.
- [Tape backup software finder](https://tapebackup.org/backup-software-finder) and [best tape backup software 2026](https://tapebackup.org/best-tape-backup-software).
- [LTO storage explained](https://tapebackup.org/lto-storage): how LTO tape storage works, the parts of a tape storage system, capacity and cost per TB; [how to store LTO tapes](https://tapebackup.org/resources/how-to-store-lto-tapes): temperature, humidity, cases, cabinets, racks and offsite rotation.
- [OWC LTO tape drives](https://tapebackup.org/resources/owc-lto-tape-drives): OWC Mercury Pro and Archive Pro; [LTO vs object storage](https://tapebackup.org/comparisons/lto-vs-object-storage): tape against S3, Wasabi and Glacier, plus S3-to-tape gateways.
- [Tape archive advisor](https://tapebackup.org/tape-archive-advisor): describe your LTO archive and get a ranked shortlist of 14 tape archive products (HSM, S3 to tape gateways, media archives) scored by the Tape Archive Software Ledger 2026, with a suggested setup and steps.
- [Why tape](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape), [LTO tape explained](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape), [LTO capacity chart](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-capacity), [LTO tape drive buying guide](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-tape-drive), [LTO tape libraries](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-library), [LTFS](https://tapebackup.org/resources/ltfs), [LTO tape data recovery](https://tapebackup.org/resources/lto-tape-data-recovery), [LTO tape lifespan](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-tape-lifespan), [LTO tape news](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-news), [LTO vs HDD](https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-vs-hdd), [LTO tape brands](https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape-brand).
- [Tape Q&A](https://tapebackup.org/tape-q-and-a) and [blog](https://tapebackup.org/blog).
- [Tape vs cloud 5-year cost](https://tapebackup.org/comparisons/tape-vs-cloud-5-year-cost) and [tape, disk and cloud compared](https://tapebackup.org/comparisons).
- [Contact and volume quotes](https://tapebackup.org/contact): tell us how many cartridges you need for a special discount.

- [What Is LTO Tape? Linear Tape-Open Explained in Under 2 Minutes](https://youtu.be/2Fal_k0P6Yc): What LTO tape is, how a drive writes it, capacity by generation, the compatibility rule, what it costs in 2026 and why people keep it offline. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/lto-tape.
- [Which LTO Tape Drive to Buy in 2026 (LTO-9 vs LTO-10, SAS vs Thunderbolt)](https://youtu.be/OUqB74x6AgQ): A buyer's guide to LTO drives: generation, form factor, interface, read/write compatibility, part numbers and used drives. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/why-tape/lto-tape-drive.
- [Tape vs Cloud: Backup Kung-Fu (500 TB, 5 Years, Real 2026 Prices)](https://youtu.be/ZPs0eTwLnmQ): An 8-bit arcade fight between LTO tape and cloud archive storage, scored with real 2026 prices for a 500 TB archive over five years. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/comparisons/tape-vs-cloud-5-year-cost.
- [How to Use LTFS on Linux, Mac and Windows (LTO Tape Like a USB Drive)](https://youtu.be/e1ANLap0inI): How LTFS works, the free tools for each OS, the Linux commands step by step, the Mac and Windows apps, and why you must always unmount. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/resources/ltfs.
- [How Many LTO Tapes Do You Need? Free Backup Calculator Walkthrough](https://youtu.be/spbiOvrW-zQ): A walkthrough of the free tapebackup.org backup calculator: data size, copies, recovery targets and the recommended LTO setup. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/backup-calculator.
- [Why Your Backup Tapes Need to Leave the Building (Offsite Tape Rotation)](https://youtu.be/z4awYQws8Lw): Why one tape set should always be outside the building, and how a weekly offsite rotation keeps it there. Embedded on https://tapebackup.org/blog/offsite-tape-backups-still-beat-most-good-enough-plans.
